summary: Frontend-only tests for iteration 20 (RnD lifecycle 7 stages, weekly RnD decision report, sample PIC end-to-end, and management alert thresholds). Most flows work as specified; found one UI integration bug where the notification bell popover shows 0 unread while backend + /api/notifications correctly stores/returns weekly-report notifications for admin.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Kirim sekarang' (POST /api/dewi/rnd/reports/weekly-decisions/send) the toast confirms 'Rapor 2026-W32 dikirim ke 4 penerima' and GET /api/notifications returns 4 rnd_weekly_decisions items for admin@garment.com, but the bell popover header shows '0 belum dibaca dari 0 total' and 'Belum ada notifikasi'. 'Lihat Semua' page also does not surface any 'Rapor keputusan RnD ...' entry. Likely the bell dropdown filters by a different `type` field (backend stores notification type='rahaza' + subtype='rnd_weekly_decisions' while /api/notifications maps `type -> subtype` when responding), so the header UI's filter/type expectations don't match.

action_items: Fix notification bell popover so RnD weekly-report notifications (type='rahaza', subtype='rnd_weekly_decisions') actually appear for management users in the header dropdown and 'Lihat Semua' page. The backend + REST API are correct — this is a purely FE mapping/filter issue.

Nice-to-have: expose a data-testid on the sidebar 'Sample Request' menu and on the row 'Submit/Ajukan' button so E2E scripts can consistently transition sample draft → submitted without relying on text.

Optional: pre-select the first real style in the Sample Request modal (currently the first '[role=option]' entry is the placeholder '-- Pilih Style --' which caused a validation toast during automated selection).
critical_code_review_comments: rnd_decision_report.send_rnd_decision_report writes notifications with type='rahaza' + subtype='rnd_weekly_decisions'. The public /api/notifications endpoint remaps subtype into the `type` field of the response payload; make sure the frontend NotificationBell component uses the same mapping — otherwise weekly reports are stored correctly but never appear in the UI.

In RnDSamplesTab modal, Style trigger is a Radix combobox whose first `[role=option]` is the placeholder '-- Pilih Style --'; consider disabling the placeholder or removing it from the option list so keyboard/automation-first selection is safer.

rca of the issue: Bell UI shows 0 notifications while /api/notifications returns them — mismatch between how notif_insert stores documents (type='rahaza', subtype='rnd_weekly_decisions') and how the NotificationBell dropdown filters/reads them. The REST API remaps subtype→type in its response, so if the bell uses a different endpoint (or filters by top-level type != 'rahaza') it will miss these entries.
